channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability curation highlights a severe concentration of critical flaws within the Microsoft ecosystem, particularly affecting Windows desktop and network components, Azure cloud services, and SQL Server, where remote code execution and local privilege escalation vectors are rampant. Attackers can leverage widespread heap-based buffer overflows and authentication bypasses in essential infrastructure services such as DNS, DHCP, and Active Directory, while web-facing platforms including Exchange Server and ASP.NET Core present significant risks for remote exploitation and session hijacking. The threat landscape further extends to industrial control and IoT deployments via command injection and authorization failures, emphasizing an immediate requirement to remediate foundational enterprise software and network devices against these high-impact exploits.
